interest: Illuminates the restoration of Japanese port authority under SCAPIN 1927 and postwar global maritime rate comparisons.
overview: This file documents the establishment, regulation, and revision of port facility and terminal charges for foreign vessels in occupied Japan throughout 1948. It details the transition from direct SCAP oversight—including initial tariff schedules and Circular No. 16—to SCAPIN 1927, which directed the Japanese Government to resume responsibility for commercial port and terminal operations. The collection also captures Far Eastern Commission diplomatic policy considerations and SCAP's comparative review of Japanese port charges against historical and contemporary global maritime tariffs.
